scholarships.title: Pacific Scholarship for Excellence in Research & Innovation (PSERI)
scholarships.official_source: The University of the South Pacific (USP)

eligibility: Be a citizen of a USP member country
Preferably be 35 years or younger for Master's studies and 45 years or younger for PhD studies at the time of application
Master's applicants must have a grade point average of at least 3.5 at undergraduate level
PhD applicants must have completed a Master's degree by thesis
Final-year undergraduate students may apply but must state their expected completion date in the application letter
existing.eligibility_summary: Citizens of a USP member country with a GPA of at least 3.5 at undergraduate level for a Master's award, or a completed Master's by thesis for a PhD award.
benefits: Book allowance of up to FJD 750 per year
Living allowance of FJD 21,600 per year for Master's and FJD 24,000 per year for PhD, paid monthly
Dependants Allowance of FJD 10,883.00 per year for qualifying awardees
Establishment Allowance of FJD 1,942.00 one-off for qualifying awardees
Research grant only after the research plan and budget are approved by the relevant Academic Unit Research Committee
One return airfare when the award holder must travel to a USP campus in another country

requirements: Not permitted to be in paid employment during the tenure of the award
Minimum 40 hours per week on research for the entire year
Contribute to teaching in the respective faculty for a maximum of eight hours per week during semester time
documents: Cover letter or letter of application
Outline of a proposed research topic (Research Intent Template)
Name and contact details of three referees
Certified true copies of relevant transcripts and certificates
application_method: Email the completed application to the USP Research Student Coordinator using the subject line "PSERI <year> Application - [Your Name]"
Attach all eight required documents in the same email
existing.selection_notes: USP funds interdisciplinary projects that fall within its Strategic Research Themes (Sustainable, Inclusive and Equitable Economies; Oceans, Ecosystems and Climate Resilience; Education, Culture, Health and Wellbeing; Governance, Justice and Equality; Innovation, Empowerment and Sustainability). Applicants may discuss their application with a potential supervisor, but the scholarship does not guarantee a place in the academic unit.
existing.best_fit: Master's by research or PhD candidates from any USP member country with a GPA of 3.5 or above who want to research Pacific-relevant topics at USP.
existing.notes: All amounts on the official page are in Fijian dollars. Award holders must enrol in their respective academic unit; the scholarship does not guarantee a place there.
existing.duration: Master's: 18 months for applicants who have completed a Postgraduate Diploma, 24 months for applicants with an Undergraduate Degree only. PhD: 36 months.
existing.application_period: The official page is marked CLOSED; the 2026 round closed at midnight on Monday 5 January 2026 and awards are tenable from early 2026. USP publishes a new, year-dated call each year, so the next round is expected to open in the same annual window.
